title: Martial Arts Attendance & Check-In Kiosk Software (2026)
description: Martial arts attendance and check-in kiosk software compared: how Kicksite, Martialytics, Gymdesk, PushPress, RhinoFit and Spark handle check-in, with prices.
h1: Martial arts attendance and check-in kiosk software
body:
Attendance matters more in martial arts than in most gyms: it drives belt test eligibility and tells you who is about to quit. Most school software offers a front-desk kiosk where students check themselves in. Here is what each vendor publishes.

We checked each vendor's own public pages between October 26 and October 30, 2026 and list only what they publish. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. We have not used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:kicksite,martialytics,gymdesk,pushpress,rhinofit,spark-membership}}

How each tool handles check-in

  • Kicksite: kiosk check-in by name, PIN or member-portal barcode, and it can block check-in for past-due balances (Kicksite attendance page). From $49/mo.
  • Martialytics: Kiosk Mode check-in app, engagement tracking and automatic absence follow-up (Martialytics features). From $69/mo.
  • Gymdesk: check-in by kiosk, name search, barcode or phone. From $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments.
  • PushPress: check-ins, kiosk mode and attendance tracking listed on the pricing page; Free plan $0/mo.
  • RhinoFit: check-in, reserve and attend, with a tablet kiosk; $0 Start Up or $57/mo Standard.
  • Spark Membership: attendance trends, and attendance feeds test eligibility. $199/mo after an 8-week trial.
  • Zen Planner: attendance listed; kiosk details unknown from the pricing page.

What to test at your front desk

  • How fast can a kid check in: name search, PIN, barcode or phone?
  • Does attendance count toward the next belt test automatically? See belt rank tracking software.
  • Can it alert you when a student stops showing up?
  • Can it stop check-in for overdue accounts, and can you override it?
  • Does the kiosk run on a tablet you already own? Hardware requirements are mostly unknown from vendor pages, so ask.

faq: Which martial arts software has a check-in kiosk?
Kicksite, Martialytics (Kiosk Mode), Gymdesk, PushPress and RhinoFit all list kiosk or tablet check-in on their own pages (checked 2026-10-26 to 2026-10-30).
Can software follow up with students who miss class?
Martialytics lists automatic absence follow-up (martialytics.com/features). For other tools, check during the free trial.
Can I block check-in for unpaid accounts?
Kicksite says it supports check-in restrictions for past-due balances (kicksite.com attendance page and FAQ).
